description: YIYUAN Accord resolves task coordination gaps in goals, capability choice, correction, continuity, verification and authorized package lifecycle alongside domain Skills in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive outcome delivery with human authority
interface.longDescription: A brief coordination Skill preserves the goal, authority, pauses and unfinished work. Four independently discoverable Skills cover capability collaboration, continuity and recovery, outcome verification, and plugin lifecycle. Native entry and recovery Hooks supply the same brief coordination body; use specialist details only when their conditions apply. Reconcile user, host and other-component changes across shared dependencies. Explicit invocation remains supported.
defaultPrompt: Tell me the outcome; I will own its supported route, correction, verification, continuity and cleanup within your authority.
